en.headline: Half of Po Pin Chau Mid-Autumn bookings did not show, AFCD says
en.dek: An average of 2,360 people reserved the Sai Kung trail each day from 25 to 27 September, but only about 1,170 arrived. A lawmaker urged fees or deposits.
body: Fewer than half of the people who reserved slots on the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geopark trail over Mid-Autumn and the weekend actually turned up, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said.

Across the three days from 25 to 27 September, bookings averaged 2,360 a day while arrivals averaged about 1,170, or nearly 50 percent of reservations. The trial booking scheme caps the section at 2,000 named visitors a day between 9am and 5pm on specified weekends and holidays, with extra same-day slots released when conditions allow.

The department said the busiest period was 10am to 2pm. Order was generally good, most visitors completed checks without waiting, and the path and viewing platform were not overcrowded. Extra staff handled verification and patrols, drones monitored the trail, and a photo point was set up on the East Dam section to spread people out. Some National Day Golden Week dates are already fully booked, and the department said it would use the three-day data to plan for that holiday.

New Territories South East lawmaker Christine Fong said the government should open standby places in real time on the booking platform and consider charging a fee or deposit. She said comparable geological parks in Shenzhen and elsewhere on the mainland charge about 80 to 100 yuan, and that income could go to conservation, education and publicity.

zh.headline: 破邊洲中秋周末近半預約未到訪 方國珊倡收費或按金
zh.dek: 漁護署指9月25至27日日均2360人預約、實際到訪約1170人；議員建議開放候補名額並考慮收費。
body: 漁護署表示，中秋及周末三日預約遊覽西貢萬宜地質步道破邊洲段的旅客，實際到訪不足一半。
9月25至27日平均每日有2360人預約，實際到訪約1170人，約佔預約數字五成。試行預約制在指定周末及假期上午9時至下午5時實施，破邊洲段每日名額2000人，當局亦會按情況釋放即時預約名額。
署方指每日高峰集中在上午10時至下午2時，秩序大致良好，大部分時間遊人毋須等候即可完成核證，山徑及觀景台未見擠擁。當局加派人手核證及巡邏，以無人機監察步道，並在東壩段增設打卡點分散人流。國慶黃金周部分日子預約已滿，署方會參考這三日數據作部署。
新界東南立法會議員方國珊認為，當局應在預約平台實時開放候補名額，並考慮日後收費或收取按金。她指深圳等地質公園入場費約80至100元人民幣，收入可用於地區保育、教育及宣傳。
